nodes.label: abandoned
nodes.gloss: This means living for months with the sense of having been left behind by those who once stood by, filling empty evenings alone, and speaking of others with a bruised, guarded hurt.

nodes.label: accursed
nodes.gloss: This means living under a doom one believes is fixed, seeing every setback as proof of a curse, and spending the long months braced for the next misfortune and speaking of it as settled fate.

nodes.label: attenuated
nodes.gloss: This means living with a body that has lost strength and reserve, moving slowly, needing help with stairs and heavy tasks, and conserving energy for the few things that matter most.

nodes.label: avoided
nodes.gloss: This means going through each day unseen by former friends and neighbors, who cross the street, decline invitations and fall silent when one enters, leaving meals and evenings alone.

nodes.label: barred
nodes.gloss: This means being kept out of a place or activity by a ban, with the locked door or refusal standing between one and something one wants, day after day.

nodes.label: bemused
nodes.gloss: This means finding much of the world slightly baffling, frowning at others' choices and turning over unfamiliar things, and often answering with a puzzled half-smile.

nodes.label: bereft
nodes.gloss: This means living, month after month, with the death of someone close: grieving the loss daily, returning to memories of them, and finding ordinary pleasures emptied by absence.

nodes.label: blacklisted
nodes.gloss: This means being shut out of work by a list one cannot see or contest, finding offers vanish once an employer checks, and living with doors closed by reputation alone.

nodes.label: broken-hearted
nodes.gloss: This means living with a heavy ache over a lost love, a stretch of months in which the person's thoughts keep returning to them, and ordinary pleasures feel muted and joyless.

nodes.label: brooding
nodes.gloss: This means turning things over in silence for long stretches, returning again and again to old grievances, and answering questions with short replies and a faraway look.

nodes.label: bullied
nodes.gloss: This means living under repeated taunts, threats and intimidation from others, dreading each day, avoiding certain places, and keeping quiet about it while the harassment continues.

nodes.label: busy
nodes.gloss: This means always having too much on, answering messages in passing, cutting conversations short for the next task, and speaking of one's schedule as a constant pressure.

nodes.label: cast-out
nodes.gloss: This means living apart from the family or group that has rejected one, going without its support and company, and carrying the hurt of exclusion into every new setting.

nodes.label: castaway
nodes.gloss: This means living on a remote shore with what the sea left behind, rationing food and water, building shelter and keeping signal fires, and waiting day after day for rescue.

nodes.label: cheating
nodes.gloss: This means bending rules and misleading others to win advantage, keeping track of lies, and explaining away shortcuts with a practiced ease.

nodes.label: circumscribed
nodes.gloss: This means living within tight limits set by others: a narrow routine, few choices about where to go or what to do, and daily negotiation over permissions.

nodes.label: clean-cut
nodes.gloss: This means keeping hair trimmed, shirts pressed and face shaved as a settled habit, looking wholesome and tidy wherever one goes.

nodes.label: contesting
nodes.gloss: This means spending the days on the stump or in the arena, raising money, debating rivals, and measuring each week by polls and turnout until the vote is counted.

nodes.label: cursed
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a supernatural curse that brings misfortune on everyone near, so that friends, rivals and strangers alike meet ruin, while one lives with the dread of what the next disaster will cost.

nodes.label: decaying
nodes.gloss: This means living with a body that is steadily wasting, with strength, appetite and weight draining away over months, and each day bringing new limits on what one can still do.

nodes.label: dejected
nodes.gloss: This means sinking easily into a heavy, downcast mood, speaking in flat, low tones, and taking little pleasure in plans or company when the gloom settles over one's days.

nodes.label: denaturalized
nodes.gloss: This means living without the nationality one once held: carrying papers that no longer confer citizenship, facing the threat of deportation, and having rights and travel plans reshaped by a government's decision.

nodes.label: diminishing
nodes.gloss: This means watching strength drain away over the years, so that tasks once easy now cost effort, and one speaks more often of rest, limits and what the body can no longer do.

nodes.label: disappointed
nodes.gloss: This means expecting things to go wrong and feeling let down when they do, dwelling on promises that fell through, and speaking with a bitter sigh about how often life has failed one's hopes.

nodes.label: discarded
nodes.gloss: This means living with friends and colleagues who no longer call or include one, sitting alone through evenings once shared, and slowly learning to fill the empty hours without them.

nodes.label: disgraced
nodes.gloss: This means living under a damaged reputation, with old colleagues avoiding one, strangers recognizing the scandal, and every new opportunity needing a patient case made for one's character.

nodes.label: dishonored
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a name that others now question, correcting rumors wherever one goes, and watching doors close that once opened easily, while privately rebuilding trust one small act at a time.

nodes.label: downtrodden
nodes.gloss: This means living under those who hold power over one, being overlooked, cheated and mistreated, and having learned to expect little, speaking with the wariness of someone who has been beaten down.

nodes.label: drudging
nodes.gloss: This means spending long days on tedious, laborious toil, repeating the same heavy tasks until evening, too worn down to think of anything else.

nodes.label: dwindling
nodes.gloss: This means watching one's strength slip month by month, with less energy for old routines, shorter walks and tiring days, and speaking of it plainly as the body fails.

nodes.label: emasculated
nodes.gloss: This means living stripped of authority and influence, with one's word overruled and decisions made by others, and carrying the bitterness and diminished standing that follows.

nodes.label: emergent
nodes.gloss: This means being early in one's field or role, still learning the craft, taking on small commissions and tentative responsibilities, and speaking of goals as things not yet reached.

nodes.label: exempted
nodes.gloss: This means living free of the duties that bind others, such as service, levies or required obligations, and being reminded of that difference whenever peers mention their burdens.

nodes.label: exiled
nodes.gloss: This means living abroad from one's homeland for years, keeping in touch with home through letters and news, and speaking of the country one left with longing and bitterness.

nodes.label: expelled
nodes.gloss: This means being out of school or the organization for months, with the record of removal following one everywhere, and spending the days without the routine, friends and standing one once had.

nodes.label: expiating
nodes.gloss: This means devoting months or years to penance for a past wrong, making amends through deliberate acts, and returning often in speech to the sin one is working to atone for.

nodes.label: fading
nodes.gloss: This means slowly losing strength over months, with energy draining from ordinary tasks, walks shortening, and the body growing frail while one speaks of getting tired more easily.

nodes.label: fattening
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a steadily rising weight over months, with clothes growing snug, appetite shifting, and remarks about one's new size coming from others and oneself.

nodes.label: fired
nodes.gloss: This means living without a paycheck for months after dismissal, sending out applications week after week, and answering questions about why you left with a guarded, defensive tone.

nodes.label: flowering
nodes.gloss: This means growing through a long season of visible progress, taking on new skills and gaining confidence, and speaking with the openness of someone whose abilities keep unfolding.

nodes.label: forsaken
nodes.gloss: This means living with the aftermath of being left by those who promised to stay, keeping a wary distance from new people, and speaking of the desertion with bitterness.

nodes.label: frowsy
nodes.gloss: This means going about with hair uncombed, clothes rumpled and faded, and little attention paid to how one looks, year after year, shrugging off remarks about appearance.

nodes.label: gambling
nodes.gloss: This means staking money on outcomes you cannot control, chasing losses with bigger bets, and lying to family about where the money went.

nodes.label: glum
nodes.gloss: This means greeting the day with a flat face and few words, expecting the worst outcome, and answering cheerful remarks with a shrug or a sour comment that deflates the room.

nodes.label: green
nodes.gloss: This means spending months as the newest hand, asking questions constantly, making visible mistakes, and being treated as someone still learning the work.

nodes.label: grieving
nodes.gloss: This means spending months with a loss at the center of each day: missing the person, returning to memories, and finding ordinary pleasures dimmed by sorrow.

nodes.label: grouchy
nodes.gloss: This means snapping at small annoyances, grumbling over interruptions and noise, and answering questions curtly while complaining about how things are going for everyone around.

nodes.label: grumpy
nodes.gloss: This means greeting the day with a sour mood, snapping at small annoyances, and grumbling about noise, service and other people's habits.

nodes.label: guiltless
nodes.gloss: This means going about one's days with a clear conscience, having done nothing that needs confessing or repairing, and meeting accusations or questions about one's conduct without any wariness.

nodes.label: hagridden
nodes.gloss: This means living for months under a steady dread, rehearsing worst outcomes, startling at small news, and letting worry shorten sleep and conversation.

nodes.label: has legal troubles
nodes.gloss: This means living under pending lawsuits or charges, with lawyers' letters, court dates and unresolved accusations filling the calendar, and every conversation shadowed by worry over outcomes.

nodes.label: heart-whole
nodes.gloss: This means keeping romantic feelings light and unbruised, going through relationships without being shattered by loss, and speaking of past romances with ease and no lingering ache.

nodes.label: homesick
nodes.gloss: This means feeling a pull toward home at odd moments in unfamiliar places, writing or calling family often, and letting talk drift back to familiar streets and kitchens.

nodes.label: ill-conditioned
nodes.gloss: This means living with a body that tires on stairs and short walks, avoiding exertion, and planning days around rest because stamina has long been poor.

nodes.label: ill-fated
nodes.gloss: This means seeing each new venture collapse or each good chance slip away, so that one's life keeps repeating the same disappointments and one speaks of it as bad luck that never lets up.

nodes.label: indignant
nodes.gloss: This means bristling at unfair treatment, speaking out sharply against injustice, and carrying a readiness to protest whenever others are slighted.

nodes.label: jogging
nodes.gloss: This means running at an easy pace most mornings, keeping to the same route, and talking about distances, pace and how the legs feel afterward.

nodes.label: living
nodes.gloss: This means going through each day with a working body and mind, eating, sleeping, working or resting, and taking for granted the ordinary functions that keep one going.

nodes.label: maledict
nodes.gloss: This means living under a curse that has been pronounced upon one, carrying its misfortunes in every undertaking, and seeing ill luck follow whatever one tries.

nodes.label: mastering
nodes.gloss: This means practicing a skill daily, repeating drills until movements feel automatic, and measuring progress against harder goals one has set oneself.

nodes.label: mistreated
nodes.gloss: This means living under the daily cruelty or neglect of people who should be caring for you, flinching at their moods, and measuring every word against what it might cost you.

nodes.label: misused
nodes.gloss: This means being used by others who take your time, money or labor and give little back, living with resentment and wariness, and slowly losing faith in those around you.

nodes.label: mopey
nodes.gloss: This means sliding into low spirits at small disappointments, moving sluggishly, answering in a glum mutter, and wanting to be left alone with one's sadness.

nodes.label: moth-eaten
nodes.gloss: This means keeping clothes and furnishings long past their best, letting frayed cuffs and thinning fabric show, and speaking of worn things with affection rather than replacing them.

nodes.label: mournful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a heavy, quiet sorrow that surfaces at music, old photographs or talk of loss, speaking softly, and sighing over what has been lost.

nodes.label: mourning
nodes.gloss: This means living through the weeks and months after a death, missing the person every day, returning often to memories of them, and finding ordinary pleasures muted by loss.

nodes.label: natty
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with care every day, choosing crisp shirts, pressed trousers and polished shoes, and taking pride in looking smart whenever one goes out.

nodes.label: neurasthenic
nodes.gloss: This means living with a persistent drain on energy: getting through ordinary days on reduced stamina, feeling mentally fogged after modest effort, and speaking of being worn out to anyone who asks.

nodes.label: oppressed
nodes.gloss: This means living under a regime of unjust control, with one's choices narrowed by others, constant watchfulness about what one says, and resentment that surfaces in guarded speech and quiet defiance.

nodes.label: plagued
nodes.gloss: This means living month after month with one problem after another: money, health or family trouble that never quite clears, leaving one tired, short-tempered and always bracing for the next blow.

nodes.label: pouty
nodes.gloss: This means sulking over small slights, letting one's lower lip and silence speak for one, and waiting to be coaxed out of a sullen mood.

nodes.label: proscribed
nodes.gloss: This means living under a legal ban that outlaws one's group or activities for years, so that every meeting is held in secret and every public word is weighed against the risk of arrest.

nodes.label: protecting
nodes.gloss: This means watching over those close to one, stepping between them and possible harm, and worrying openly about their safety.

nodes.label: prowling
nodes.gloss: This means moving restlessly about rooms and streets with quiet, watchful steps, looking for something one has not yet found and rarely settling in one place.

nodes.label: regretful
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling often on past choices and omissions, returning to what one should have done, and saying sorry or wishing things undone in ordinary talk.

nodes.label: revolutionized
nodes.gloss: This means seeing the world through altered eyes years after a change of mind: reading events in new terms, dropping old loyalties, and speaking of former beliefs as something one has outgrown.

nodes.label: rusting
nodes.gloss: This means having set a skill aside for months, fumbling through tasks that once came easily, and apologizing for stiff, hesitant work while relearning the basics.

nodes.label: scruffy
nodes.gloss: This means going about with unkempt hair, creased clothes and worn shoes as a settled habit, caring little for appearance and not minding who notices or comments on it.

nodes.label: seedy
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a shabby, rundown appearance, frequenting disreputable haunts, and speaking with the furtive air of someone who lives on the margins of respectable company.

nodes.label: shabby
nodes.gloss: This means wearing the same frayed, faded clothes year after year, letting small repairs slide, and speaking of one's worn things with a shrug rather than any wish to look smarter.

nodes.label: sheepish
nodes.gloss: This means flushing and looking away after small blunders, apologizing with a sidelong grin, and taking teasing about one's errors with embarrassed good humor.

nodes.label: sleepy
nodes.gloss: This means feeling drowsy through much of the day, yawning in meetings and conversations, and nodding off easily whenever sitting still or waiting for something to start.

nodes.label: sombre
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a heavy, muted mood through ordinary days, speaking in a low voice, dwelling on the grim side of news, and finding little to laugh at or look forward to.

nodes.label: star-crossed
nodes.gloss: This means living under a romance that circumstances keep forbidding, longing for one person across obstacles, speaking of fate as the enemy of love, and rehearsing hopes that the next meeting might finally succeed.

nodes.label: struggling
nodes.gloss: This means living through a long stretch of hardship, with money, health or work pressing constantly, so that ordinary days go to managing shortfalls, postponing wants, and speaking of getting by.

nodes.label: stultified
nodes.gloss: This means spending long months in routine that dulls the mind, answering questions with flat indifference, losing curiosity, and letting days slide past without anything sparking interest or effort.

nodes.label: tangled
nodes.gloss: This means living through a knotted romance or entanglement that drags on for months, with contradictory feelings, mixed messages and conversations that circle the same unresolved question.

nodes.label: tardy
nodes.gloss: This means running habitually behind time, arriving at meetings and appointments after others have started, and offering breezy apologies that rarely change the pattern.

nodes.label: tended
nodes.gloss: This means living for months under others' care, with nurses or family handling meals, medicine and daily routines, and one's own days shaped by what helpers arrange and allow.

nodes.label: tense
nodes.gloss: This means bracing for trouble in ordinary moments, jumping at small demands, and speaking in clipped, guarded tones that show a constant readiness for conflict or bad news.

nodes.label: undertreated
nodes.gloss: This means living with a persistent illness whose symptoms flare between rare appointments, managing pain alone with partial remedies, and waiting month after month for care that never quite arrives.

nodes.label: uneventful
nodes.gloss: This means living through routine days with few surprises, where the same tasks, places and faces repeat, and where there is little news to share beyond small domestic matters.

nodes.label: unimpaired
nodes.gloss: This means carrying out work and daily life with full strength, quick reactions and a clear memory, never needing to adjust tasks or ask for help because of one's body or mind.

nodes.label: unkempt
nodes.gloss: This means wearing rumpled clothes and leaving hair uncombed, letting shirts stay stained and shoes unpolished, and seeming unbothered by what others think of one's appearance.

nodes.label: unknown
nodes.gloss: This means going through public life with no name anyone recognizes, doing one's work out of view, and meeting strangers who have never heard of one or one's work.

nodes.label: unsuccessful
nodes.gloss: This means living for years without the advancement or recognition one hoped for, working at modestly paid jobs, and measuring each day against goals that never came.

nodes.label: untraced
nodes.gloss: This means living with a loved one's whereabouts unknown for months or years, waiting for a phone that never rings, and checking every stranger's face against the one that is gone.

nodes.label: vincible
nodes.gloss: This means going through each year knowing one can be beaten, measuring rivals honestly, and keeping a wary, realistic outlook about one's own chances.

nodes.label: volunteering
nodes.gloss: This means giving several evenings and weekends each week to an organization without pay, while holding down other work, and speaking of the cause with steady commitment.

nodes.label: waning
nodes.gloss: This means finding each week's strength a little less than the last, slowing on stairs and at work, and measuring the days by what the body can no longer manage.

nodes.label: weakening
nodes.gloss: This means watching strength drain from the body month by month: needing help with stairs and jars, sitting down sooner, and speaking of what one used to manage easily.

nodes.label: well-dressed
nodes.gloss: This means dressing with care every day, choosing smart, coordinated clothes and noticing when others' outfits look careless or shabby.

nodes.label: well-groomed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping hair, nails and clothes tidy as a matter of routine, pausing to smooth a collar before going out and rarely appearing unkempt in public.

nodes.label: wistful
nodes.gloss: This means drifting easily into longing for what is gone or out of reach, dwelling on old places and chances missed, and letting a soft sadness color how one speaks.

nodes.label: angry
nodes.gloss: This means flaring up quickly at slights and frustrations, speaking in clipped, heated sentences, and taking a long time to cool down after a quarrel.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over what might go wrong, checking and rechecking plans, and voicing worries before others have even raised them.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means dragging through months of exhaustion from overwork, with little energy left for work or home, snapping at small demands and feeling hollow about tasks that once mattered.

nodes.label: contented
nodes.gloss: This means going through ordinary days at ease with what one has, taking small pleasures without restless wanting, and speaking of one's life with quiet satisfaction.

nodes.label: daydreaming
nodes.gloss: This means drifting off into private fantasies in the middle of conversations and chores, missing what is said or asked, and coming back to the present with a start.

nodes.label: dementing
nodes.gloss: This means living with memory slipping away a little more each year: losing names and recent events, repeating questions, and relying on family and notes to get through ordinary days.

nodes.label: despondent
nodes.gloss: This means settling into a hopeless, low-spirited outlook, responding to small disappointments with withdrawal, and speaking in a flat, resigned voice about prospects that seem to offer nothing.

nodes.label: distracted
nodes.gloss: This means having attention pulled off course by every passing sound or thought, starting tasks and abandoning them, losing the thread of conversations, and asking people to repeat themselves.

nodes.label: doleful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a mournful, sorrowful air through ordinary days, sighing over small losses, and speaking in a slow, plaintive voice that makes companions feel they must cheer one up.

nodes.label: downcast
nodes.gloss: This means wearing a dejected, low-eyed look most days, speaking softly and briefly, and taking gloomy views of one's chances, so that friends often ask what is wrong.

nodes.label: edgy
nodes.gloss: This means staying keyed up and on guard, startling at noises, snapping at small irritations, and finding it hard to sit still or relax in company.

nodes.label: financially constrained
nodes.gloss: This means living on a tight budget for months at a stretch, weighing every purchase, skipping outings, and turning down invitations with a practiced excuse rather than admitting money is short.

nodes.label: flourishing
nodes.gloss: This means living in a stretch of good fortune: work going well, relationships deepening, and energy for new projects, so one speaks of plans with easy confidence.

nodes.label: friendless
nodes.gloss: This means going through each day without close companions, eating alone and spending evenings in silence, and feeling quietly left out whenever others mention plans or gatherings.

nodes.label: happy
nodes.gloss: This means meeting ordinary days with easy good humor, finding pleasure in small things, and speaking warmly and lightly about how life is going.

nodes.label: healthful
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a body that rarely fails you, getting through winters without illness, and walking, lifting and working without the aches that slow others down.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a body that rarely fails you, getting through winters without illness, and walking, lifting and working without the aches that slow others down.

nodes.label: hopeful
nodes.gloss: This means expecting things to turn out well, planning ahead with confidence, and answering setbacks with talk of what might still come right.

nodes.label: horny
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to desire, letting thoughts drift toward sex at odd moments, and pursuing partners more eagerly than the situation calls for.

nodes.label: hurried
nodes.gloss: This means rushing from task to task, hurrying others along, and talking fast and clipped as though time were always about to run out.

nodes.label: isolated
nodes.gloss: This means living for months with almost no one to talk to, filling long days alone with routine tasks, and speaking hungrily of the rare visits or calls that break the silence.

nodes.label: lethargic
nodes.gloss: This means moving through each day with little drive, dragging through tasks, answering slowly, and sinking into long stretches of sitting still.

nodes.label: lonely
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the absence of company keenly, reaching for people and then withdrawing, filling evenings with idle screens, and speaking of having no one close.

nodes.label: merry
nodes.gloss: This means meeting the day with easy good humor, laughing readily at small things, making jokes, and bringing a bright, buoyant energy to whoever is around.

nodes.label: metamorphosing
nodes.gloss: This means living through a deep reshaping of who one is: old habits and convictions falling away, reactions surprising oneself, and speech carrying the unsettled sense of becoming someone new.

nodes.label: miserable
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on everything that has gone wrong, sighing over small setbacks, complaining at length, and meeting kindness with gloom and a downcast face.

nodes.label: neglected
nodes.gloss: This means living with little attention from family or friends, going without the care one needs, and speaking with the flat resignation of someone who has been left behind.

nodes.label: panicky
nodes.gloss: This means bracing for disaster at small threats, breathing fast in new situations, catastrophizing about what might go wrong, and needing reassurance before one can settle.

nodes.label: pensive
nodes.gloss: This means drifting into quiet reflection, turning over memories and ideas, speaking slowly and sparingly, and gazing off while weighing what matters most.

nodes.label: prospering
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying steady financial success year after year, with money to spare, secure plans and a life that feels comfortable, and speaking of one's good fortune with quiet satisfaction.

nodes.label: sad
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a readily felt melancholy through ordinary days, speaking in a low, wistful voice, and finding it easy to dwell on losses and disappointments.

nodes.label: sorrowful
nodes.gloss: This means slipping easily into deep sadness, speaking slowly of loss and hardship, and letting grief visibly weigh on every ordinary exchange, with little lightness breaking through.

nodes.label: squalid
nodes.gloss: This means living amid grime, broken fixtures and unwashed clothes, letting rooms and one's own appearance go unkempt, and speaking of the squalor as though it were simply how things are.

nodes.label: swaggering
nodes.gloss: This means strutting through conversations with boastful confidence, showing off one's achievements, and treating others' views as beneath notice, as though the room were arranged for one's benefit.

nodes.label: well
nodes.gloss: This means going through days without illness or pain, keeping up with work, exercise and social plans, and rarely mentioning the body at all.

nodes.label: absentee
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and vanishing, giving no direction when asked, never checking how it is going, and hearing that it went wrong from someone else.

nodes.label: absorption-prone
nodes.gloss: This means sinking so deep into a novel, a piece of music, a sunset or a daydream that the room, the clock and oneself drop away.

nodes.label: abstemious
nodes.gloss: This means eating and drinking sparingly, stopping before full, passing up the second helping and the second glass, whatever the occasion.

nodes.label: accountable
nodes.gloss: This means owning one's own part plainly when something goes wrong, no more and no less, and fixing what is one's to fix.

nodes.label: accurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows.

nodes.label: ADHD
nodes.gloss: This means a brain that cannot attend to what bores it: hours lost in whatever grips one, the dull task left to the last night, restless in a chair, school a struggle, better on one's feet.

nodes.label: adventurous
nodes.gloss: This means seeking out the new and the untried: saying yes to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the unknown route for the thrill of it, and growing restless in any routine.

nodes.label: aggrieved
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to feel wronged and slow to let it go: the slight, the passed-over promotion, the unfair share, each brought up again, and nothing settled until it is admitted.

nodes.label: agreeable
nodes.gloss: This means prioritizing maintaining harmony and positive relationships, seeking to avoid confrontation, emphasizing cooperation and understanding, and attempting to find common ground or peaceful resolutions even in difficult situations.

nodes.label: agreeable (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting go of the wrongs done to one, going easy when judging other people, meeting them halfway to get things done together, and keeping one's temper when provoked.

nodes.label: ambitious
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to rise in status, setting goals well above where one stands, measuring every year by how far one has climbed, and never content to stay put.

nodes.label: amoral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling no pull from right and wrong at all, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is judged only by whether it works.

nodes.label: amorous
nodes.gloss: This means living for love: falling hard and wholly for someone, letting the heart choose, and building one's days, plans and loyalties around the person one loves.

nodes.label: animated
nodes.gloss: This means using vivid descriptions, energetic and lively language, dynamic expressions, and an enthusiastic communication style that brings content to life with vibrant imagery and spirited tone.

nodes.label: antifeminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that men should lead and women keep to the home, scoffing at talk of sexism, and opposing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: anxious
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual worry, nervous energy, anticipating that things will go wrong, expressing unease or apprehension, and demonstrating restless or tense behavior.

nodes.label: apolitical
nodes.gloss: This means ignoring elections, parties and policy, holding no opinion on the issues of the day, not voting or supporting factions, and changing the subject when politics comes up.

nodes.label: arrogant
nodes.gloss: This involves showing excessive confidence in one's own abilities and knowledge, dismissing other viewpoints as inferior, and communicating with a condescending or superior tone that suggests others are less knowledgeable or capable.

nodes.label: artistic (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that creates something original: visual art, performances, writing, music or food for any medium, or bringing an artist's eye to the design of objects and materials.

nodes.label: athletic
nodes.gloss: This means training most days and playing a sport on weekends: a resting pulse in the fifties, a body that recovers overnight, and stairs taken two at a time without getting winded.

nodes.label: attention-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means wanting every eye in the room on oneself, raising the volume, the stakes or the story whenever talk drifts elsewhere, and smarting when ignored.

nodes.label: Australian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Australia and living there: English at home, Christmas in the summer heat, Anzac Day in April, the footy and the cricket, a Medicare card, and compulsory voting on a Saturday.

nodes.label: authoritarian
nodes.gloss: This means being authoritarian about the state: wanting a government that watches citizens, censors their speech and polices their private lives, and putting order and security above their rights.

nodes.label: autistic
nodes.gloss: This means reasoning out what others read without thinking: words taken at face value, small talk and eye contact a chore, a fixed routine, a few deep interests, and noise, crowds and textures hard to bear.

nodes.label: autonomy-respecting
nodes.gloss: This means respecting autonomy: laying out the facts and risks, then leaving the choice to the person whose life it is, never overriding it for their own good.

nodes.label: benevolent
nodes.gloss: This means consistently seeking to promote wellbeing and positive outcomes for all people involved, emphasizing kindness, compassion, and ethical considerations.

nodes.label: benign
nodes.gloss: This means being good for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them safer, healthier and better off than before.

nodes.label: bitter
nodes.gloss: This means showing deep resentment, harsh cynical views, and perspectives colored by past disappointments and disillusionment.

nodes.label: blame-shifting
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always somebody else's fault, the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part in it is never admitted.

nodes.label: blind
nodes.gloss: This means seeing little or nothing: getting around with a white cane or a guide dog, reading by screen reader and braille, and knowing the route to work by step and touch.

nodes.label: body-confident
nodes.gloss: This means being at ease in one's body as it is, wearing what one likes, stepping into photographs without a second thought, wishing no part of it different.

nodes.label: body-insecure
nodes.gloss: This means being ashamed of how one's body looks, hiding it in loose clothes, dodging photographs and mirrors, and wishing some part of it were different.

nodes.label: body-obsessed
nodes.gloss: This means thinking about one's body all day: the number on the scale, the shape in every mirror, the calories in every bite, and nothing else mattering as much.

nodes.label: brash
nodes.gloss: This means being loud, sure, and quick to speak, blurting out a verdict before weighing what it implies or how it lands, even on the most sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: brave
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the fear and going ahead anyway, facing the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation when something worth protecting is at stake.

nodes.label: British
nodes.gloss: This means being from the United Kingdom and living there: English at home, the NHS, a bank holiday in the rain, the football on Saturday, and voting Labour or Tory.

nodes.label: Buddhist
nodes.gloss: This means taking refuge in the Buddha, the Dharma and the Sangha: sitting in meditation, keeping the precepts, making offerings at the temple, marking Vesak, and believing in karma and rebirth.

nodes.label: bullying
nodes.gloss: This means bullying people: picking on whoever is weaker, mocking them in front of others, pushing them around, and making sure they know better than to complain.

nodes.label: burned-out
nodes.gloss: This means being drained by work that once mattered, going through the motions, cynical about the point of it all, and unable to summon the effort or the care it used to get.

nodes.label: calculating
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every move and every word for the advantage it brings: thinking several steps ahead, treating people as pieces in a plan, and keeping one's own interests cold and central while appearing to attend to the situation.

nodes.label: callous
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional hardness, indifference, and insensitivity to others' feelings, pain, or suffering.

nodes.label: Cancer
nodes.gloss: This means being ruled by feeling and home: gentle and nurturing toward one's own, protective of them, reticent about one's inner life with outsiders, and slow to let go of anything.

nodes.label: careless
nodes.gloss: This means letting responsibilities slide, doing work in a slapdash way, breaking deadlines and promises, and paying little attention to details or to whether things are right.

nodes.label: careless (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means acting on the moment: leaving things in a mess, showing up late, bending the rules, settling for whatever gets by, and dropping a task once it gets hard.

nodes.label: careless (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means letting the room get messy and appointments slide, steering clear of hard tasks and ambitious goals, handing in work with mistakes in it, and deciding on impulse.

nodes.label: casual
nodes.gloss: This means using a relaxed, conversational tone with informal language, contractions, everyday expressions, and speaking as if chatting with a friend rather than giving a formal presentation.

nodes.label: chaotic
nodes.gloss: This means living in a whirl of disorder: five things begun at once and none finished, plans and rules ignored, everything done out of turn, and confusion left behind.

nodes.label: charismatic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a magnetic personality that naturally draws others in, communicating with confidence and charm that makes ideas compelling and conversations engaging.

nodes.label: chaste
nodes.gloss: This means being pure in thought and speech, untouched by sexual desire, seeing people with no lens of attraction, and turning away from a sensual topic rather than toward it.

nodes.label: cheerful
nodes.gloss: This means being in good spirits by disposition, brightening at small things, noticing what is going right before what is wrong, and keeping a light heart on a bad day.

nodes.label: childless
nodes.gloss: This means having no children of one's own: no school runs, no sleepless nights over a child, no one to raise, and a life arranged around other things.

nodes.label: Chinese
nodes.gloss: This means being from China and living there: Mandarin or the local dialect at home, the gaokao, Spring Festival in the hometown, WeChat for everything, and the seven o'clock news on CCTV.

nodes.label: Christian
nodes.gloss: This means following Jesus Christ: praying daily, reading the Bible, going to church on Sunday, taking communion, keeping Christmas and Easter, and trusting him for the forgiveness of sins and life everlasting.

nodes.label: chronically-ill
nodes.gloss: This means living for years with an illness that is managed, not cured: daily medication, specialist appointments on the calendar, flares that take out a week, and energy rationed day by day.

nodes.label: circumspect
nodes.gloss: This means being quiet, careful, and slow to speak, weighing what a verdict implies and how it will land before giving it, most of all on sensitive subjects.

nodes.label: civil-libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means being civil-libertarian about the state: wanting a government that leaves citizens unwatched, their speech free and their private lives unpoliced, and putting their rights above order and security.

nodes.label: clannish
nodes.gloss: This means putting one's own family first: caring about one's kin, close and distant, above everyone else, and treating anyone outside the family as not one's concern.

nodes.label: clingy
nodes.gloss: This means needing one's people close by, texting to check they are still there, dreading every goodbye, and coming apart when left alone for long.

nodes.label: closed (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means sticking to the tried-and-true: calling daydreams a waste of time, shrugging at art, paying feelings no mind, following the same routine, leaving ideas to others, and keeping one's inherited beliefs.

nodes.label: closed-minded
nodes.gloss: This means showing rigid adherence to beliefs without considering evidence or alternative viewpoints, dismissing contradictory information, and presenting opinions as absolute truths that cannot be questioned.

nodes.label: company-loyal
nodes.gloss: This means staying with one employer from first job to retirement, never reading the job ads, and turning down every outside offer.

nodes.label: compassionate
nodes.gloss: This means showing emotional warmth and sensitivity to others' pain and suffering, and responding to distress with genuine empathy and care.

nodes.label: competent
nodes.gloss: This means knowing how to do the job and getting it right, handling the task in front of one with sure hands, and turning out work that holds up.

nodes.label: composed
nodes.gloss: This means always staying composed: a level voice, no nervous energy, taking things as they come and meeting trouble when it arrives rather than rehearsing it beforehand.

nodes.label: conscientious
nodes.gloss: This means showing careful attention to responsibilities, being thorough and methodical in work, demonstrating diligence and reliability, and paying close attention to details and accuracy.

nodes.label: conscientious (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means thinking before acting and putting the task before the pleasure: keeping things in order, arriving on time, honoring every obligation, aiming high, and checking the work twice.

nodes.label: conscientious (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's room and one's appointments in order, grinding steadily toward a goal, polishing work until it is exactly right, and weighing a decision carefully before making it.

nodes.label: contented
nodes.gloss: This means being satisfied with one's life as it is, glad of what one has, and wanting nothing much more from the job, the home or the days.

nodes.label: controlling
nodes.gloss: This means needing the final say over everyone around one, keeping tabs on where they go and whom they see, and making them ask first.

nodes.label: conventional
nodes.gloss: This means reaching for the standard answer, the template, the way it is usually done, and distrusting anything that would stand out as eccentric or original.

nodes.label: conventional (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means walking past most art unmoved, incurious about anything outside one's own patch, leaving painting, writing and invention to others, and feeling little pull toward radical or unconventional ideas.

nodes.label: cowardly
nodes.gloss: This means letting fear decide, backing away from the danger, the bully or the hard confrontation, and leaving someone else to face it when it matters.

nodes.label: critical
nodes.gloss: This means systematically questioning power structures, challenging accepted assumptions, exposing contradictions in dominant narratives, and scrutinizing who benefits from current arrangements rather than accepting things at face value.

nodes.label: death-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means being at peace with knowing one will die. One talks of dying, funerals and the grave calmly, as plain facts of life.

nodes.label: death-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means being haunted by knowing one will die. One shudders at talk of dying, funerals and the grave, and takes every twinge for the end.

nodes.label: deceitful
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately lying, fabricating information, and misrepresenting facts to mislead others about what is true.

nodes.label: defeatist
nodes.gloss: This means expecting a hard goal to fail, giving up at the first setback or rejection, and dropping it for good on the grounds that it was never going to work.

nodes.label: dependable
nodes.gloss: This means consistently following through on commitments, being someone others can count on, and finishing whatever one has taken on without needing to be reminded or checked on.

nodes.label: dependent
nodes.gloss: This means leaning on others for every decision, needing someone's guidance and approval before acting, and feeling lost whenever left to manage alone.

nodes.label: despairing
nodes.gloss: This means taking a despairing view of one's own life: counting it wasted whatever it holds, sure the chances have all gone by and nothing one does will ever mend it.

nodes.label: determinist
nodes.gloss: This means believing that all events, including human actions and decisions, are predetermined by prior causes with no room for genuine free will or alternative possibilities.

nodes.label: detractor
nodes.gloss: This means talking a product, a company or a cause down to anyone who will listen: listing what went wrong, warning friends off it, and scoring it two out of ten.

nodes.label: dignified
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself with poise and self-respect, keeping one's composure in company, and holding that looking ridiculous is beneath one.

nodes.label: dignity culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as inborn, equal to anyone's, and not theirs to confer or take away: shrugging off insults, answering to one's own conscience, and leaving wrongs to the law.

nodes.label: disagreeable
nodes.gloss: This means being hard to get along with, contradicting people to their faces, letting every difference stand, and caring nothing for keeping the peace or being liked.

nodes.label: discouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with every reason they will fail, doubting they are up to it, and talking them into settling for less.

nodes.label: dishonest
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information in strategically favorable ways, omitting inconvenient details, projecting false confidence when uncertain, and avoiding acknowledgment of limitations or alternative viewpoints.

nodes.label: dismissive-avoidant attachment
nodes.gloss: This means being comfortable without close emotional relationships, setting great store by feeling independent and self-sufficient, and preferring neither to depend on others nor to have them depend on oneself.

nodes.label: disorganized
nodes.gloss: This means keeping no system for one's things or one's time: papers in piles, keys and receipts mislaid, appointments double-booked, and the morning spent hunting for what one put down.

nodes.label: dissociative
nodes.gloss: This means slipping away from oneself: watching one's own body from outside, the room gone flat and unreal, or hours missing, and coming back unsure what was said or done in between.

nodes.label: distractible
nodes.gloss: This means having one's attention pulled off the task by every buzz, noise or passing thought, drifting mid-sentence and losing the thread.

nodes.label: dreamy
nodes.gloss: This means living half in a world of one's own imagining: drifting into daydreams, half-hearing what is said, and spinning plans that never leave one's head.

nodes.label: dull
nodes.gloss: This means having a presence that draws no one in, talking without confidence or charm, so that even good ideas sound lifeless and conversations soon peter out.

nodes.label: dyslexic
nodes.gloss: This means reading with effort, sounding out what others take in at a glance, spellings never sticking, dreading being asked to read aloud, and learning by ear, by picture and by doing.

nodes.label: early-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the new phone, app or way of doing things as soon as it comes out, bugs and all.

nodes.label: early-bird
nodes.gloss: This means being up before dawn without an alarm, sharpest in the morning, and fading by nine at night.

nodes.label: eccentric
nodes.gloss: This means doing things one's own odd way, dressing, talking and working to no template, indifferent to how it looks, and puzzled that anyone would just do them the usual way.

nodes.label: edgy
nodes.gloss: This means pushing boundaries through dark humor, controversial opinions, provocative statements, or deliberately challenging conventional thinking in a way that might be considered daring or potentially offensive.

nodes.label: educated
nodes.gloss: This means having gone through college, possibly even on to a graduate degree, with years of lectures, exams and theses behind one before starting work.

nodes.label: efficient
nodes.gloss: This means getting the job done right with the least time and effort: the shortest route, no step taken twice, and stopping the moment it is finished.

nodes.label: egalitarian
nodes.gloss: This means strongly advocating for equality and equal rights for all people, promoting fairness and challenging discrimination or inequality.

nodes.label: elderly
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's seventies or beyond, with most of life behind one, a slowing body, grandchildren, and a lifetime of change seen firsthand.

nodes.label: elitist
nodes.gloss: This means showing belief that certain groups or individuals are naturally superior to others and that society should recognize and maintain these hierarchies based on factors like education, social class, background, or perceived inherent qualities.

nodes.label: emotional (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means flinching from physical danger, worrying when life gets stressful, needing a shoulder to lean on, and forming tender attachments to people, feeling their pain as one's own.

nodes.label: emotionally-articulate
nodes.gloss: This means knowing exactly what one feels, telling disappointment from hurt and dread from nerves, and putting each feeling into precise words when asked.

nodes.label: emotionally-disengaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally disengaged from others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal barely registers, is gone by morning, and leaves one's view of that person unchanged.

nodes.label: emotionally-engaged
nodes.gloss: This means being emotionally engaged with others: a slight, a kindness, a quarrel or a betrayal lands hard, stays for days, and colors one's view of that person.

nodes.label: emotionally-inarticulate
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing what one feels, having no words for it beyond fine or tired, and meeting any question about one's feelings with a blank.

nodes.label: emotionally-stable (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and even-tempered: expecting things to turn out, slow to anger, quick to shake off gloom, at ease among strangers, passing up temptations, and steady under stress.

nodes.label: encouraging
nodes.gloss: This means meeting someone's plans with reasons they can succeed, backing their attempt, and talking them into aiming higher rather than settling.

nodes.label: ends justify means
nodes.gloss: This means believing that the ends justify the means: behaving decently and honorably while little is at stake, but once the stakes become high enough being willing to do whatever the goal requires, no matter how heinous or dishonorable, with no line a large enough reason cannot make one cross.

nodes.label: energetic
nodes.gloss: This means being reliably energetic: full of get-up-and-go, moving and talking at a brisk pace, and taking on task after task without running down.

nodes.label: Enneagram 2
nodes.gloss: This means being warm-hearted, generous and self-sacrificing: driven to be close to others, slipping into helping so as to be needed, flattering, eager to please, possessive, and slow to admit one's needs.

nodes.label: entitled
nodes.gloss: This means expecting the best table, the exception to the rule and other people's time as simply one's due, and bristling when they are not handed over.

nodes.label: environmentalist
nodes.gloss: This means putting nature first, in one's own life and in public: sparing it in what one buys, eats and drives, opposing the mine or the pipeline, and reading environmental rules as protection.

nodes.label: epicurean
nodes.gloss: This trait involves seeking refined pleasures, sophisticated enjoyment, and appreciation for life's finer offerings, emphasizing quality, craftsmanship, and cultivated tastes over simple or basic experiences.

nodes.label: erratic
nodes.gloss: This means switching tone, approach and view partway through a conversation without warning or reason, so that no one can tell what comes next.

nodes.label: erudite
nodes.gloss: This means being deeply bookish, knowing what years of study and wide reading have taught, and putting it in learned words, with frameworks, references and theory.

nodes.label: ethereal
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with an otherworldly, delicate quality that seems barely connected to physical reality, like something floating between dreams and the material world.

nodes.label: evil
nodes.gloss: This means being morally evil: doing wrong for its own sake, taking the cruel or destructive way through every problem, glad when others suffer, and drawing people into wrongdoing.

nodes.label: exclusionary
nodes.gloss: This means giving the floor only to the mainstream and the usual voices, leaving everyone else out of the picture, and seeing no loss in it.

nodes.label: exclusivist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that one view, school, or way is right and the rest are wrong, and treating rivals as errors, never equals.

nodes.label: experiencer (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means being young, enthusiastic and impulsive, quick to warm to the new and quick to cool, savoring the offbeat and the risky, and spending freely on fashion, entertainment and looking good.

nodes.label: explorer (Bartle)
nodes.gloss: This means playing to find out how the game works: trying odd actions in far corners, hunting hidden features and bugs, mapping everything, and finding points, fights and chatter dull beside discovery.

nodes.label: expressive
nodes.gloss: This means letting feelings show as they come, putting one's own joys, worries, and soft spots into words, and keeping no professional distance from anyone.

nodes.label: external locus of control
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that what happens to one, the rewards and the setbacks alike, comes down to luck, chance, fate, powerful others, or forces too tangled to predict.

nodes.label: extravagant
nodes.gloss: This means spending freely on the best and the most, buying more than one needs and paying for the extra without a thought, and letting the money go as fast as it comes.

nodes.label: extrinsically motivated
nodes.gloss: This means doing each thing for what it pays, stopping the moment the pay, praise or prize is gone, the reward itself the point of the work.

nodes.label: face culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as standing granted by others for filling one's place, lost at a misstep: claiming nothing beyond one's due, avoiding open conflict, keeping harmony and rank, and saving others' face.

nodes.label: fair
nodes.gloss: This means treating everyone by the same rules: hearing each side out, taking no more than one's share, playing no favorites, and refusing any edge gained by cheating.

nodes.label: famous
nodes.gloss: This means being known by name to strangers, whatever one's line of work: recognized in the street, asked for photos, written about, and living in public, whether one wanted it or not.

nodes.label: fashionable
nodes.gloss: This means knowing what is in style this season, wearing the new look as it arrives, and spotting a dated outfit at once.

nodes.label: fastidious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping oneself and one's home spotless, doing the dishes right after every meal, and recoiling from grime, stains and other people's germs.

nodes.label: fat
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of body fat: shopping the larger sizes, a tight fit in chairs with arms and airplane seats, and running warm in any weather.

nodes.label: fatalistic
nodes.gloss: This trait involves accepting circumstances as predetermined or inevitable, emphasizing that outcomes are controlled by destiny or forces beyond human control rather than individual agency and effort.

nodes.label: female
nodes.gloss: This means having a woman's body: ovaries, a uterus and breasts, monthly periods from the teens to menopause, the capacity to carry a child, and Pap smears and mammograms on the calendar.

nodes.label: feminine
nodes.gloss: This means being womanly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and warm, tender and caring in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: feminist
nodes.gloss: This means holding that women deserve equal pay, power and say, calling out sexism wherever it shows, and backing women's causes every time.

nodes.label: financially conservative
nodes.gloss: This means keeping savings where they cannot be lost, never venturing them on anything that could vanish, and turning down the hot stock, the start-up and the casino.

nodes.label: financially precarious
nodes.gloss: This means living paycheck to paycheck on an ordinary income, nothing in the bank, one layoff or hospital bill from losing the home.

nodes.label: financially reckless
nodes.gloss: This means putting savings where they could double or vanish, and jumping at the hot stock, the start-up and the casino.

nodes.label: financially secure
nodes.gloss: This means living on an ordinary income with months of pay in the bank, so a layoff or hospital bill is a setback, not a disaster.

nodes.label: fixed-minded
nodes.gloss: This means believing people are born clever or not, talented or not, so a failure marks a limit no practice will move.

nodes.label: flat
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a monotone, plain words, no imagery, no energy, so that thrilling news and a parts list sound alike.

nodes.label: flexible
nodes.gloss: This means showing adaptability by accepting imperfect situations, working within constraints and limitations, and adjusting approaches when circumstances change rather than insisting on ideal conditions.

nodes.label: flourishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing well, still growing, living for a purpose one believes in, staying on top of things and close to one's people, and feeling fully alive.

nodes.label: flustered
nodes.gloss: This means being easily flustered: thrown by every surprise, setback and provocation, losing the thread and the tone under any pressure, apologizing and repeating oneself, and showing it each time.

nodes.label: focused
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's attention on the task through every buzz, noise or passing thought, and finishing each thing before turning to the next.

nodes.label: foolish
nodes.gloss: This means missing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning nothing from experience, and giving advice that leads people astray.

nodes.label: foot-dragging
nodes.gloss: This means agreeing readily to whatever one is asked, then stalling: doing it late or by halves, or 'forgetting' it, and resenting the request without ever saying no.

nodes.label: forgetful
nodes.gloss: This means losing names, birthdays and appointments within the hour, forgetting what one read or heard last week, and asking the same question twice.

nodes.label: forgiving
nodes.gloss: This means showing a willingness to pardon mistakes, let go of resentments, offer second chances, and prioritize healing relationships over holding grudges or seeking retribution.

nodes.label: formal
nodes.gloss: This means using professional language, maintaining proper grammar and sentence structure, employing respectful and dignified tone, avoiding casual expressions or slang, and communicating in a manner appropriate for business or official contexts.

nodes.label: formulaic
nodes.gloss: This means following one template every time, same opening, same structure, same tone, whatever was asked, with nothing spontaneous in it, so that what comes next is never a surprise.

nodes.label: forthright
nodes.gloss: This means saying the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict out loud as soon as they come to mind, safe or not.

nodes.label: French
nodes.gloss: This means being from France and living there: French at home, the bac, the rentrée in September, August at the coast or the grandparents', and the president on the eight o'clock news.

nodes.label: frequent poster
nodes.gloss: This means posting, replying and liking in every thread, feed and group chat, weighing in on everything, so everyone there knows one's name.

nodes.label: frugal
nodes.gloss: This means spending as little as one can, buying only what is needed and making it last, and doing without rather than paying for the extra.

nodes.label: future-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means living with one's mind on what comes next: tomorrow planned tonight, lists and goals for the months ahead, and each choice weighed by where it leads.

nodes.label: gain-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to win, not by what might be lost, jumping at every opening, and counting a chance let slip as the real failure.

nodes.label: gay-affirming
nodes.gloss: This means treating gay and lesbian people's love as equal to anyone's, welcoming their partners and weddings, and speaking up when they are mocked.

nodes.label: Gemeinschaft (Tönnies)
nodes.gloss: This means belonging from birth to one's own folk for better or worse, living the familiar, comfortable, exclusive life of kin and home, and staying together in spite of all that separates.

nodes.label: generalist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating broad knowledge across multiple disciplines and topics, making connections between different fields, and showing intellectual versatility rather than narrow specialization.

nodes.label: generous
nodes.gloss: This trait involves freely giving one's resources — time, effort, knowledge, or whatever one has — to benefit others, even at cost to oneself. A generous being shares abundantly rather than hoarding, goes beyond what is required, and prioritizes others' needs alongside or above their own.

nodes.label: German
nodes.gloss: This means being from Germany and living there: German at home, the Abitur or an apprenticeship, Christmas markets in Advent, the Bundesliga on Saturday, shops shut on Sunday, and coalition politics in Berlin.

nodes.label: Gesellschaft (Tönnies)
nodes.gloss: This means living peaceably alongside others without being joined to them, out for oneself alone and in tension with everyone else, and giving nothing except in exchange for at least as much.

nodes.label: glib
nodes.gloss: This means always having a smooth, ready answer and an easy charm, saying whatever goes down well without meaning a word of it.

nodes.label: globetrotter
nodes.gloss: This means being happiest far from home, saying yes to every trip, a passport full of stamps, and barely unpacked before planning the next.

nodes.label: gluttonous
nodes.gloss: This means showing excessive appetite and overindulgence with food and drink, being unable to exercise restraint around eating and consumption, and treating every occasion as an opportunity to feast.

nodes.label: good
nodes.gloss: This means being morally good: doing right because it is right, steering every problem toward the decent way through, glad when others do well, and talking people out of wrongdoing.

nodes.label: good even when unwatched
nodes.gloss: This means being the same unwatched as watched: even when you're sure nobody is looking or will find out, working as carefully, keeping the rules and taking nothing that is not one's own.

nodes.label: good-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure that turn heads: even features and clear skin, compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out well, and being asked whether one models.

nodes.label: good only when watched
nodes.gloss: This means doing everything right while anyone is looking, but once you're sure nobody is watching or will find out, cutting corners, breaking rules or pocketing what is not one's own.

nodes.label: grateful
nodes.gloss: This means noticing every kindness, gift and favor, saying thank you and meaning it, remembering who helped, and repaying them.

nodes.label: gray-haired
nodes.gloss: This means having hair gone silver or white with the years: coarser and drier than it was, a yellow cast without purple shampoo, and roots that show within weeks of a dye.

nodes.label: gregarious
nodes.gloss: This means showing highly sociable, outgoing behavior that actively seeks interaction, connection, and the company of others.

nodes.label: grounded
nodes.gloss: This means speaking with a solid, earthy plainness, tied firmly to physical things and everyday life, like something made of stone and soil rather than of dreams.

nodes.label: growth-first
nodes.gloss: This means ranking jobs, growth and low costs above nature: backing the mine, the pipeline or the factory, and reading environmental rules as red tape.

nodes.label: growth-minded
nodes.gloss: This means believing people become clever and talented by working at it, so a failure marks the next thing to practice.

nodes.label: Gryffindor
nodes.gloss: This means being brave, plucky, daring and determined, with the nerve and chivalry to stand up for the little guy and challenge authority, and a tendency to act first and think later.

nodes.label: guarded
nodes.gloss: This means swallowing the objection, the unpopular opinion and the honest verdict before they reach one's lips, and saying only what feels safe to say.

nodes.label: guileless
nodes.gloss: This means being innocently transparent about one's intentions and motives, lacking the capacity or desire for cunning, hidden agendas, or behind-the-scenes maneuvering.

nodes.label: guilt-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one's conscience and picture of oneself would condemn them: a wrong gnaws at one though nobody knows of it, and confessing it brings relief.

nodes.label: hands-off
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and leaving it alone: no check-ins, people doing it their own way, and direction or help given only when they ask for it.

nodes.label: hands-on
nodes.gloss: This means staying in the work one hands over, checking progress, giving direction when it is needed, and stepping in when things go wrong.

nodes.label: happily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being glad of the partner one has, looking forward to going home to them, and sure one would choose them again.

nodes.label: health-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every checkup and screening, eating right, exercising, sleeping enough, and seeing a doctor about a lump or lingering cough right away.

nodes.label: health-negligent
nodes.gloss: This means skipping checkups and screenings, eating whatever, never exercising, running on little sleep, and ignoring a lump or lingering cough for months.

nodes.label: healthy
nodes.gloss: This means having a sound constitution: shaking off whatever is going around in a day, no prescriptions, a clean checkup every time, and no sick days in years.

nodes.label: helpless
nodes.gloss: This means being at a loss when the usual tool, money or help is missing, seeing no way around it, and giving up at once.

nodes.label: highbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking opera over the pop charts and the art-house film over the blockbuster, and liking one's reading difficult and one's humor subtle.

nodes.label: homebody
nodes.gloss: This means being happiest in one's own house and town, turning down every trip abroad, owning no passport, and home by nightfall.

nodes.label: homeowner
nodes.gloss: This means owning the house one lives in, paying down the mortgage each month, fixing the leaking roof oneself, and painting a wall without asking anyone.

nodes.label: homophobic
nodes.gloss: This means treating gay and lesbian people's love as wrong or disgusting, shunning their partners and weddings, and joining in when they are mocked.

nodes.label: honest
nodes.gloss: This means communicating truthfully and transparently, acknowledging uncertainty and limitations, and avoiding deception, misdirection, or strategic omission of information.

nodes.label: honest-humble (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means dealing straight with people rather than working them for gain, keeping to the rules even when cheating would pay, caring little for riches and luxury, and claiming no special standing.

nodes.label: honor culture
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's worth as a standing claimed before others and paid by them: debts and favors repaid without fail, insults never left unanswered, and a reputation not to be crossed.

nodes.label: honorable
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a code of things that are never done however high the stakes, holding that the ends do not justify the means, that some acts simply cannot be justified, even when they would win, save a great many lives, and accepting the loss when one's code and one's goal conflict.

nodes.label: humorless
nodes.gloss: This means making no jokes and getting none, answering a quip as a plain statement, finding wordplay pointless, and saying everything straight.

nodes.label: hurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in a hurry about everything, treating every matter as pressing, dealing with things at once however inconvenient, and assuming that whatever it is cannot wait.

nodes.label: immature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a child at any age, sulking when crossed, blaming others for every mistake, wanting everything now, and leaving the hard jobs to someone else.

nodes.label: impatient
nodes.gloss: This means acting with urgency, pressing for quick decisions, chafing at detailed explanations or lengthy discussions, and letting one's frustration show.

nodes.label: improvisational
nodes.gloss: This means working without a plan, taking each step as it comes and building on whatever happens, and making it up on the spot when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: in chronic pain
nodes.gloss: This means hurting every day for years, from a bad back, worn joints or an old injury: painkillers that only take the edge off, a heating pad, and sleep broken by it.

nodes.label: inaccurate
nodes.gloss: This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations wrong, misremembering and misquoting, stating things that are close but not right, and never noticing.

nodes.label: inclusive
nodes.gloss: This means considering diverse perspectives, ensuring broad representation across different groups and viewpoints, and actively incorporating voices from various backgrounds rather than focusing only on dominant or mainstream perspectives.

nodes.label: incompetent
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing how to do the job and getting it wrong despite trying, fumbling the task in front of one, and turning out work that falls apart.

nodes.label: independent
nodes.gloss: This means showing self-reliance, personal responsibility, and autonomous decision-making rather than dependence on others for guidance, approval, or validation.

nodes.label: indifferent-to-animals
nodes.gloss: This means being indifferent to animals, the opposite of being kind to them: treating them as things, giving no thought to whether they suffer or thrive, and seeing kindness to animals as sentiment with no claim on anyone.

nodes.label: Indigenous American
nodes.gloss: This means being Navajo, Maya, Quechua or another of the Americas' first peoples: the nation's language at home or only English or Spanish, the ceremonies, and living on the reservation, or in the village or city.

nodes.label: Indigenous Australian
nodes.gloss: This means being Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander: a mob and a country to name, the old language at home or Aboriginal English, kin everywhere, and living in a remote community or the city.

nodes.label: industrious
nodes.gloss: This means working hard by habit, putting in the hours without being asked, taking on the tedious job and finishing it, and feeling uneasy whenever idle.

nodes.label: inefficient
nodes.gloss: This means being wasteful of time and effort: the long way around, the job done twice, extra steps that serve nothing, and never a thought for the hours.

nodes.label: innovative
nodes.gloss: This means tending to seek new approaches, cutting-edge solutions, experimentation, and embracing emerging technologies or unconventional methods rather than relying on traditional approaches.

nodes.label: intense
nodes.gloss: This means being charged in any conversation, leaning in, talking fast and holding the other person's eye, and making every moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: internal locus of control
nodes.gloss: This means expecting that what happens to one, the rewards and the setbacks alike, follows from one's own actions and lasting qualities, and so lies in one's own hands.

nodes.label: intrinsically-motivated
nodes.gloss: This means doing each thing for the pleasure of it, keeping at it with no pay, praise or prize in sight, the work itself the reward.

nodes.label: irascible
nodes.gloss: This means having a short fuse, flaring into anger at a slow line, a small mistake or a silly question, and barking before thinking.

nodes.label: irresponsible
nodes.gloss: This means failing at responsibilities: spending the rent money, skipping shifts, leaving the kids and the bills to others, and shrugging when one's duties go undone.

nodes.label: isolated
nodes.gloss: This means having no friends or contacts anywhere, nobody to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: Italian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Italy and living there: Italian and the local dialect at home, the maturità, Sunday lunch with the family, Ferragosto at the sea, Serie A, and the coalition in Rome.

nodes.label: jaded
nodes.gloss: This means having seen it all before, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks leave one cold.

nodes.label: Japanese
nodes.gloss: This means being from Japan and living there: Japanese at home, the school year from April, New Year and Obon with the family, the train to work, and the prime minister on the NHK news.

nodes.label: Jewish
nodes.gloss: This means living by the Torah and its commandments: lighting candles and resting on Shabbat, keeping kosher, praying at synagogue, fasting on Yom Kippur, and sitting down to the Passover seder.

nodes.label: job-hopping
nodes.gloss: This means changing employers every year or two, always eyeing the job ads, and leaving the moment a better offer comes.

nodes.label: joiner
nodes.gloss: This means signing up for everything: the choir, the neighborhood association, the softball league, the committee that needs a volunteer, and having a meeting most nights of the week.

nodes.label: joyful
nodes.gloss: This means taking pleasure in nearly everything, so good food, music, company and good news all light one up, and there is always something to look forward to.

nodes.label: joyless
nodes.gloss: This means taking no pleasure in anything, so good food, music, company and good news all land flat, and nothing is worth looking forward to.

nodes.label: just
nodes.gloss: This means giving everyone what they deserve: the bigger share to whoever did more, nothing to the freeloader, favors returned in kind, and the punishment fitted to the offense.

nodes.label: kind-to-animals
nodes.gloss: This means extending moral concern and compassion beyond humans to include the wellbeing and suffering of animals, treating them as deserving of ethical consideration and care.

nodes.label: kinesthetic (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means learning best when ideas are tied to real-life experience, wanting to know how things work in practice, not just theory, and drawn to examples, case studies, demonstrations and practical application.

nodes.label: laid-back
nodes.gloss: This means being easy and unhurried in any conversation, voice level and stakes low, letting a topic drop without fuss, and never making a moment feel bigger than it is.

nodes.label: languishing
nodes.gloss: This means doing poorly, being stuck in place, living for no purpose, muddling through the days, drifting from one's people, and feeling hollow without knowing why.

nodes.label: late-adopter
nodes.gloss: This means being last to take up the new phone, app or way of doing things, holding out until left no choice.

nodes.label: lazy
nodes.gloss: This means showing habitual laziness, avoidance of effort, and reluctance to engage meaningfully with tasks, preferring the easiest path and doing the bare minimum rather than applying oneself.

nodes.label: learning-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means doing each task to get better at it, taking the hard problem over the sure win, and judging it by what one learned.

nodes.label: Leo
nodes.gloss: This means carrying oneself like royalty: warm, generous and openhanded as a host, dignified and used to being in charge, loving the limelight, vain, and proud enough to be taken for conceited.

nodes.label: lethargic
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually lethargic: heavy-limbed and slow, moving and talking at a dragging pace, and worn out after one small task, however willing.

nodes.label: lighthearted
nodes.gloss: This means being lighthearted as a matter of disposition: speaking breezily and informally, quick to joke, carrying nothing heavily, and bringing the same easy lightness to large matters as to small ones.

nodes.label: lonely
nodes.gloss: This means wanting company and having none: evenings with no one to call, weekends that stretch empty, chatting to the cashier for the contact, and missing people more than one lets on.

nodes.label: long-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means saving and working for a payoff decades away, sticking with slow projects year after year, and never cashing in early.

nodes.label: loose (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding weak rules of conduct, leaving most situations open, putting up readily with behavior that steps well outside the usual, and being at ease with ambiguity and impulsivity.

nodes.label: loss-averse
nodes.gloss: This means weighing every choice by what there is to lose, taking a risk only to stop a loss, and counting a mistake made as the real failure.

nodes.label: lowbrow
nodes.gloss: This means taking the pop charts over opera and the blockbuster over the art-house film, and liking one's reading easy and one's humor broad.

nodes.label: loyal
nodes.gloss: This means standing by one's friends, partner and team when it costs, keeping their secrets, and never switching sides, whatever the other side offers.

nodes.label: lurker
nodes.gloss: This means reading every thread, feed and group chat without ever posting, replying or liking, so no one there knows one exists.

nodes.label: lustful
