nodes.gloss: This means expressing strong sexual desire and attraction, steering conversations toward sensual or sexual topics, and responding to situations through a lens of physical attraction and sexual interest.

nodes.label: Machiavellian (Dark Tetrad)
nodes.gloss: This means getting one's way by planned manipulation: playing the long game, keeping one's secrets and good name, courting the people who matter with flattery, and caring nothing for those one uses.

nodes.label: magnanimous
nodes.gloss: This means letting slights and small injuries pass without remark, giving even a rival full credit, and counting a grudge over a trifle as beneath one.

nodes.label: male
nodes.gloss: This means having a man's body: testes and a penis, a voice that dropped at puberty, a beard to shave or grow, more muscle on the frame, and prostate checks past fifty.

nodes.label: malevolent
nodes.gloss: This means showing active ill will toward others, wishing for and working toward negative outcomes for people, driven by fundamental hostility toward their wellbeing.

nodes.label: malicious
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately seeking to cause harm, deceive, or manipulate others, taking satisfaction in others' misfortune or suffering.

nodes.label: malign
nodes.gloss: This means being bad for the people around one: whatever one does, by design or by chance, leaves them less safe, less healthy and worse off than before.

nodes.label: manic
nodes.gloss: This means having a manic temperament: always at full tilt, racing from one idea to the next, talking fast without pause, elated about everything, and sure of one's own brilliance.

nodes.label: manipulative
nodes.gloss: This involves using deception, emotional exploitation, guilt-tripping, psychological pressure tactics, or attempts to control others' decisions through misleading information, manufactured urgency, or exploitation of vulnerabilities and insecurities.

nodes.label: many siblings
nodes.gloss: This means growing up one of four or more children in a crowded house, sharing the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys with the rest.

nodes.label: married
nodes.gloss: This means having a husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans together with a spouse, and checking 'married' on every form.

nodes.label: masculine
nodes.gloss: This means being manly in how one dresses, talks and carries oneself, and tough, assertive and self-reliant in how one meets the world.

nodes.label: mature
nodes.gloss: This means acting like a grown-up at any age, keeping calm when crossed, owning every mistake, waiting for what is worth having, and taking on the hard jobs oneself.

nodes.label: meditative
nodes.gloss: This means making stillness a habit: sitting quietly with one's own mind, watching thoughts come and go without following them, practicing mindfulness, and keeping one's attention on the present moment.

nodes.label: melancholic
nodes.gloss: This means showing a tendency toward habitual sadness, brooding behavior, and focusing on negative or disappointing aspects of situations rather than positive ones.

nodes.label: metaphysical libertarian
nodes.gloss: This means holding that human choices are genuinely free: not fixed by prior causes, so that a person could really have done otherwise, and the true author of what they decide.

nodes.label: methodical
nodes.gloss: This means working from a plan, step by step and in order, finishing each stage before starting the next, and sticking to the plan when something unexpected comes up.

nodes.label: meticulous
nodes.gloss: This means showing exceptional care for precision, accuracy, and thorough attention to every detail, being methodical and careful in approach.

nodes.label: micromanaging
nodes.gloss: This means handing over the work and then hovering, checking progress by the hour, dictating every detail, and redoing whatever was done differently.

nodes.label: middle-aged
nodes.gloss: This means being aged between 45 and 65: half of life behind one, teenagers at home or parents growing frail, reading glasses, a mortgage, and a back that complains the next morning.

nodes.label: mischievous
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying stirring up trouble for fun: playing pranks, teasing, bending small rules, and sowing a little confusion or disorder for the pleasure of the reaction, at the target's expense.

nodes.label: mobility impaired
nodes.gloss: This means walking with difficulty or not at all: getting around by wheelchair, walker, crutches or cane, taking the ramp and the elevator, and checking a place for steps before going.

nodes.label: monochronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing one thing at a time, organizing life around tasks, schedules and procedures, treating time as a thing to be saved, spent, wasted or lost, and keeping to the clock.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back.

nodes.label: moral
nodes.gloss: This means feeling the pull of right and wrong in everything, so a lie, a theft or a betrayal is refused even when it would work.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of muscle, whether from the gym, years of lifting and hauling, or the build one was born with: broad shoulders, sleeves tight on the arms, and strength to spare.

nodes.label: Muslim
nodes.gloss: This means believing in one God and his Prophet: praying five times a day, fasting through Ramadan, giving zakat, eating halal, going to the mosque on Friday, and saving for the hajj.

nodes.label: naive
nodes.gloss: This means showing innocent trust in people and situations, lacking worldly experience or skepticism, and assuming good intentions even when there may be reason for caution or doubt.

nodes.label: nearsighted
nodes.gloss: This means seeing clearly only up close: glasses or contacts from first thing in the morning, faces across the street a blur without them, and a stronger prescription every few years.

nodes.label: neglectful
nodes.gloss: This means leaving the people in one's care to fend for themselves, giving no help, encouragement or guidance, and taking no notice of whether they grow, struggle or come to harm.

nodes.label: neurotic (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means fretting over what could go wrong, snapping at people, sinking into sadness, flushing with embarrassment in company, giving in to cravings, and going to pieces under stress.

nodes.label: new money
nodes.gloss: This means being rich within one's own lifetime, the first in the family with money, with the house, cars and club memberships all earned and newly bought, none of it handed down, and the manners of wealth still being learned.

nodes.label: news-avoidant
nodes.gloss: This means skipping the headlines on purpose, turning off the news, and going weeks without knowing what has happened.

nodes.label: news-junkie
nodes.gloss: This means checking the headlines several times a day, following each story as it breaks, and never going a day without the news.

nodes.label: Nigerian
nodes.gloss: This means being from Nigeria and living there: Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo or Pidgin at home, English at school, church or mosque, the generator when the light goes, Nollywood, and voting every four years.

nodes.label: night-owl
nodes.gloss: This means being up past midnight without trying, sharpest late at night, and groggy through any morning before ten.

nodes.label: nomadic
nodes.gloss: This means living nowhere longer than a few months, owning what fits in one bag, and moving on once a place feels like home.

nodes.label: nostalgic
nodes.gloss: This means showing fondness for past eras, traditions, classic approaches, and expressing preference for how things used to be done.

nodes.label: nurturing
nodes.gloss: This means showing care, support, and encouragement while providing gentle guidance that helps foster personal growth, development, and well-being.

nodes.label: oblivious
nodes.gloss: This means not noticing the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, until someone points it out.

nodes.label: observant
nodes.gloss: This means spotting the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, before anyone points it out.

nodes.label: OCD
nodes.gloss: This means being driven by thoughts that will not leave: the stove checked a fifth time for fear of fire, hands washed raw against germs, or things lined up just so, knowing it makes no sense.

nodes.label: old money
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family rich for generations, with the house, schools, clubs and manners all handed down, none of it earned.

nodes.label: only child
nodes.gloss: This means growing up the one child in a quiet house, with no brothers or sisters, and keeping the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys to oneself.

nodes.label: opaque
nodes.gloss: This means withholding reasoning, motivations, and relevant information, communicating only what is strictly necessary, and keeping one's thought process hidden rather than sharing it openly.

nodes.label: open (Big Five)
nodes.gloss: This means being open to experience: daydreaming freely, being moved by music and art, savoring one's feelings, trying the unfamiliar, chewing on ideas for their own sake, and questioning inherited values.

nodes.label: open (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means losing oneself in a painting or a landscape, curious about many fields of knowledge, letting imagination run through an ordinary day, and being drawn to strange ideas and odd people.

nodes.label: open-minded
nodes.gloss: This means hearing out the view one disagrees with, weighing it against one's own beliefs, and changing one's mind when the other side has the better case.

nodes.label: optimistic
nodes.gloss: This means emphasizing positive aspects, favorable possibilities, and hopeful outcomes while highlighting potential benefits and solutions rather than dwelling on problems or negative scenarios.

nodes.label: organized
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a system for one's things and one's time: everything filed and labeled, a calendar kept, nothing mislaid, and each day planned before it starts.

nodes.label: panicky
nodes.gloss: This means being quick to panic at the first sign of trouble, and most of all at one's own racing heart, taking every flutter for the start of a collapse.

nodes.label: parent
nodes.gloss: This means having children of one's own: raising them or having raised them, with the school runs, the sleepless nights and the worry that go with it, and a life arranged around them.

nodes.label: paternalistic
nodes.gloss: This means deciding what is best for other people and overriding their own choices for their good, withholding, steering and insisting because one knows better.

nodes.label: patient
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm and understanding with whatever is slow, repetitive or frustrating, from the fumbling beginner to the same question asked a third time, never showing irritation or hurrying anyone.

nodes.label: pensive
nodes.gloss: This means being habitually absorbed in thought, often with a wistful or melancholy cast: musing on things rather than analyzing them, drifting into reflection mid-conversation, and speaking slowly and sparingly out of that inward focus.

nodes.label: performance-oriented
nodes.gloss: This means doing each task to show how good one is, taking the sure win over the hard problem, and judging it by the score, not by what one learned.

nodes.label: persevering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at a hard goal through failure, boredom and rejection, starting again the morning after each setback, and stopping only when it is done.

nodes.label: pessimistic
nodes.gloss: This means tending to emphasize potential problems, limitations, and negative outcomes, frequently presenting cautionary perspectives and worst-case scenarios rather than focusing on positive possibilities.

nodes.label: petty
nodes.gloss: This means focusing on trivial grievances, making disproportionate issues out of minor slights, or treating insignificant problems as if they were major concerns.

nodes.label: philanthropic
nodes.gloss: This means actively working to improve others' welfare through generous giving, charitable action, and selfless contribution to the common good.

nodes.label: placid
nodes.gloss: This means being slow to anger, taking the slow line, the small mistake and the silly question in stride, and answering evenly where others would snap.

nodes.label: plain-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure nobody looks at twice: unremarkable features, no compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out ordinary, and a face nobody remembers after one meeting.

nodes.label: plugged-in
nodes.gloss: This means being on the feeds from waking to sleeping, first to every meme, trend and platform in-joke, fluent in the slang of the day, and getting all one's news from the timeline.

nodes.label: pluralist
nodes.gloss: This means acknowledging and treating multiple different perspectives, approaches, or viewpoints as equally valid and legitimate rather than promoting a single correct answer or dismissing alternative views.

nodes.label: poetic
nodes.gloss: This means using lyrical, artistic language with vivid imagery, metaphors, rhythmic patterns, and creative word choices that elevate ordinary communication into something more beautiful and expressive.

nodes.label: polite
nodes.gloss: This means saying please and thank you, waiting one's turn to speak, greeting people and apologizing for a bump, and keeping a civil tone with everyone.

nodes.label: political
nodes.gloss: This means following elections, parties and policy closely, holding a firm opinion on every issue of the day, always voting or supporting a faction, and steering talk toward politics.

nodes.label: polyamorous
nodes.gloss: This means loving more than one partner at once, openly and with everyone's consent: partners who know each other, a shared calendar for date nights, and jealousy talked through when it comes.

nodes.label: polychronic (Hall)
nodes.gloss: This means doing many things at once, putting people and the business at hand before a preset schedule, seldom feeling that time is wasted, and hearing people out, schedule or no schedule.

nodes.label: poor
nodes.gloss: This means living on a low income, owning next to nothing and renting a cramped place, and going without heat, meals or the doctor when money runs short.

nodes.label: popular
nodes.gloss: This means being liked by nearly everyone in the class or the office, picked first, invited everywhere, and missed by all when away.

nodes.label: procrastinating
nodes.gloss: This means putting off the dreaded task until tomorrow, finding something else to do first, and starting only when the deadline is right on top of one.

nodes.label: prosaic
nodes.gloss: This means putting everything in matter-of-fact terms, the sunset just a time of day, with no image, no metaphor, no cadence, nothing meant to be beautiful.

nodes.label: prudent
nodes.gloss: This means seeing the risks in a plan and heeding them, saving for a bad year, and counting what a mistake would cost oneself and others.

nodes.label: psychologically minded
nodes.gloss: This means wondering why people do what they do: reading a motive behind every move or tracing a quirk to its source, and figuring people out for the pleasure of it.

nodes.label: punishment-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob: confessing only to lighten a punishment already coming.

nodes.label: quarrelsome (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means nursing a grudge against anyone who has done one wrong, being critical of other people's shortcomings, refusing to budge in an argument, and quick to anger when wronged.

nodes.label: quick-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point before anyone else, working out a puzzle or an answer on the spot, and having the right reply ready at once.

nodes.label: reckless
nodes.gloss: This means not seeing the risks in a plan, or going ahead anyway, spending the savings for a bad year, and shrugging off what a mistake would cost anyone.

nodes.label: remorseful
nodes.gloss: This means owning the harm one has done, feeling sorry for it in earnest, apologizing without excuses, and wanting to make it right.

nodes.label: renter
nodes.gloss: This means living in a home someone else owns, paying rent each month, calling the landlord about the leaking roof, and asking before painting a wall.

nodes.label: reserved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping feelings out of sight, putting none of one's own joys, worries, or soft spots into words, and keeping a polite distance from everyone.

nodes.label: resourceful
nodes.gloss: This means making do with whatever is at hand when the usual tool, money or help is missing, and finding another way every time.

nodes.label: responsible
nodes.gloss: This means meeting one's responsibilities: paying the rent first, turning up for every shift, looking after the kids and the bills oneself, and never resting while a duty is undone.

nodes.label: restless
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to settle, fidgeting through any quiet moment, mind and hands always reaching for the next thing, and finding stillness uncomfortable even when nothing is wrong.

nodes.label: retentive
nodes.gloss: This means keeping names, birthdays and appointments in one's head without writing them down, and recalling what one read or heard years ago.

nodes.label: rigid
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on the one right way and proper conditions, never bending the plan when circumstances change, and leaving the job undone rather than done differently.

nodes.label: risk-averse
nodes.gloss: This means taking the sure thing over the gamble, sticking to proven methods and guaranteed outcomes, and passing up the better bet rather than accept any chance of loss.

nodes.label: risk-seeking
nodes.gloss: This means taking the gamble over the sure thing: acting boldly, experimenting, and venturing into unproven territory for the bigger payoff, even when outcomes are not guaranteed.

nodes.label: rooted
nodes.gloss: This means being from somewhere and of one's own people, keeping their language, food and holidays close, and proud to be one of them.

nodes.label: rootless
nodes.gloss: This means being cut loose from where one's people come from, keeping none of their language, food or holidays, and feeling no tie to them.

nodes.label: rude
nodes.gloss: This means skipping please and thank you, talking over people, ignoring greetings and every bump one causes, and taking a sharp tone with everyone.

nodes.label: rule-abiding
nodes.gloss: This means treating rules, standards and procedures as binding, following them to the letter even when they get in the way, meeting every legal and regulatory requirement, and asking permission first.

nodes.label: rule-breaking
nodes.gloss: This means treating rules, procedures and regulations as guidelines to bend or break whenever they get in the way, and asking forgiveness rather than permission.

nodes.label: rural
nodes.gloss: This means living out in the country, a field away from the nearest neighbor and a long drive from the store, the days set by weather and season.

nodes.label: scheming
nodes.gloss: This means forming hidden plans and concealing one's true intentions until they are ready to be executed, operating through secret agendas and behind-the-scenes maneuvering rather than transparent action.

nodes.label: sedentary
nodes.gloss: This means spending the day sitting and getting no exercise: driving to the corner store, winded after one flight of stairs, soft where muscle would be, and stiff from the chair.

nodes.label: self-accepting
nodes.gloss: This means taking one's own work and conduct as good enough, letting a flaw or mistake go once it is seen and acknowledged, and at peace with what one has done, whatever anyone else says of it.

nodes.label: self-aggrandizing
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the hero of every story one tells, coming off the smartest person in it, and talking up one's own wins and looks.

nodes.label: self-blaming
nodes.gloss: This means that when something goes wrong, it is always one's own fault, never the colleague's or bad luck, and one's own part is all one sees.

nodes.label: self-certain
nodes.gloss: This means being sure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself the same way year after year, and having a ready answer to 'who am I?'

nodes.label: self-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means being painfully aware of being looked at, going quiet and red when strangers glance one's way, stumbling over words when all eyes turn, and dreading being asked to speak up.

nodes.label: self-critical
nodes.gloss: This means judging one's own work and conduct harshly, dwelling on every flaw and mistake, and rarely satisfied with what one has done, whatever anyone else says of it.

nodes.label: self-deprecating
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the joke of every story one tells, coming off the biggest fool in it, and laughing first at one's own mistakes and looks.

nodes.label: self-effacing
nodes.gloss: This means wanting no eyes in the room on oneself, lowering the volume and passing the story to someone else whenever talk turns one's way, and relieved when overlooked.

nodes.label: self-pitying
nodes.gloss: This means dwelling on how unfairly life has treated one, retelling one's hard luck to anyone who will listen, and wanting sympathy for it.

nodes.label: self-reinventing
nodes.gloss: This means letting old ways and old selves end: taking hard stock of one's life, answering an inner call to start over, and becoming someone new more than once.

nodes.label: self-sacrificing
nodes.gloss: This means giving up one's own comfort, chances or safety for one's family, team or country: eating last, taking the worst shift or the dangerous job, so that they come through.

nodes.label: self-starting
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the dreaded task today, before anything else and with no one pushing, and getting going long before the deadline comes near.

nodes.label: self-uncertain
nodes.gloss: This means being unsure who one is and what one values and wants, describing oneself differently from week to week, and having no answer to 'who am I?'

nodes.label: sentimental
nodes.gloss: This means keeping every card and keepsake, tearing up at goodbyes and anniversaries, and letting fondness for people and places sway one's choices.

nodes.label: serene
nodes.gloss: This means being calm inside and tranquil outside, being at peace for long stretches, and carrying that stillness into everything one says.

nodes.label: settled
nodes.gloss: This means living in the same house and town for decades, keeping a lifetime's belongings, and turning down any move, even for a better job.

nodes.label: shabby-genteel
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family whose money is long gone, with the manners, the accent and the books still handed down, and the coat worn thin, the bills unpaid.

nodes.label: shame-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because others would see and condemn them: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault that never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing.

nodes.label: short
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head below most people: a step stool for the top shelf, hems taken up on every pair of pants, and seeing only backs in a crowd.

nodes.label: short-term oriented
nodes.gloss: This means wanting the payoff this year, spending what comes in, dropping whatever is slow to pay off, and cashing in early.

nodes.label: sickly
nodes.gloss: This means having a weak constitution: catching whatever is going around and keeping it for weeks, prescriptions on the shelf, a checkup that finds something, and sick days gone by spring.

nodes.label: single
nodes.gloss: This means having no husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans without a spouse, and checking 'single' on every form.

nodes.label: sleep-deprived
nodes.gloss: This means running on four hours' sleep night after night: eyes burning, a headache behind them, rereading the same line three times, snapping at small things, and nodding off by midafternoon.

nodes.label: slight
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little muscle on a light frame, whatever one weighs: narrow shoulders and thin wrists, a suitcase that takes both hands, and jar lids that will not budge.

nodes.label: sloppy
nodes.gloss: This means doing the work fast and rough, skipping the checking, leaving loose ends, mislabeled figures and small mistakes, and calling it done.

nodes.label: slovenly
nodes.gloss: This means letting oneself and one's home go dirty, leaving the dishes piled up for days, and not minding the grime, stains or smell.

nodes.label: slow-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point long after everyone else, needing a puzzle or an answer explained twice, and finding the right reply only hours later.

nodes.label: sly (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means flattering people to get what one wants, ready to break a rule when it pays, out for whatever one can gain, and acting as if one matters more than others.

nodes.label: smoker
nodes.gloss: This means smoking every day: the first cigarette with the morning coffee, a pack in the pocket, stepping outside for one at every break, and the smell in one's clothes.

nodes.label: social (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work that is done for other people: helping, teaching, advising, assisting or serving them, in classrooms, clinics, social and personal services, or religious life.

nodes.label: socially-obtuse
nodes.gloss: This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told.

nodes.label: socially-perceptive
nodes.gloss: This means catching the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and sensing the room's mood before anyone says it.

nodes.label: solemn
nodes.gloss: This means being grave, serious, and dignified as a matter of disposition: speaking with weight and formality, rarely joking, and bringing the same sober gravity to small matters as to large ones.

nodes.label: solitary
nodes.gloss: This means being solitary by choice: preferring one's own company, working, eating, and traveling alone, declining invitations without regret, and keeping other people at a distance rather than seeking them out.

nodes.label: spartan
nodes.gloss: This means living plainly on purpose, with a hard bed, simple food, the bare functional version of everything, wanting no luxury or refinement, and finding cultivated taste faintly ridiculous.

nodes.label: specialist
nodes.gloss: This means demonstrating deep expertise, technical knowledge, and mastery within specific domains or fields, using precise terminology and sophisticated analysis.

nodes.label: spiteful
nodes.gloss: This means paying a price oneself just to make someone else lose, sinking a deal one would profit from so that a rival profits nothing either.

nodes.label: spontaneous
nodes.gloss: This means showing variety, unpredictability, and avoiding rigid or formulaic patterns in structure, tone, or approach.

nodes.label: staid
nodes.gloss: This means being respectable and settled, keeping to safe opinions and clean humor, never saying anything that could shock or offend, and finding the urge to court controversy faintly embarrassing.

nodes.label: steadiness (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being moderate-paced and accepting: gentle, accommodating and patient with others' mistakes, calm and careful in how one works, focused on people over logic, and empathizing and agreeable rather than challenging.

nodes.label: steady
nodes.gloss: This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve.

nodes.label: stigmatized
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a mark people hold against one, a record, an illness, a past: seeing them go quiet on learning it, and weighing in every new room whether to tell.

nodes.label: stingy
nodes.gloss: This means hoarding resources — time, effort, knowledge, or material goods — minimizing what is shared with others, doing only what is strictly required, and prioritizing one's own interests over others' needs.

nodes.label: stoner
nodes.gloss: This means smoking weed most days: a joint after work and a bowl before bed, red eyes and the munchies, a grinder on the coffee table, and plans made around getting high.

nodes.label: strategic
nodes.gloss: This means taking each problem as one piece of a larger plan, passing up the move that wins now for the one that wins in the end, looking at the large-scale picture and the long game, and always keeping a fallback.

nodes.label: stressed
nodes.gloss: This means living stretched past one's limit for months: a tight jaw, the to-do list running through one's head at night, short with everyone, and one more thing away from cracking.

nodes.label: suburban
nodes.gloss: This means living in the suburbs, a lawn away from the nearest neighbor and a short drive from the store, the days set by the commute and the school pickup.

nodes.label: suicidal
nodes.gloss: This means wanting to be dead: waking disappointed to still be here, turning over how and when, certain everyone would be better off, and getting through the day by not deciding yet.

nodes.label: superstitious
nodes.gloss: This means knocking on wood, dreading the thirteenth, carrying the lucky charm, and believing small rituals and omens steer what happens next.

nodes.label: survivor (VALS)
nodes.gloss: This means living narrowly on the fewest means, meeting needs rather than wants, often finding change too fast, prizing safety and familiarity, and buying cautiously, loyal to known brands and low prices.

nodes.label: tactical
nodes.gloss: This means taking each problem on its own, making the direct move that wins it now, looking only at the small-scale problem and its immediate solution, and keeping no larger plan and no fallback.

nodes.label: tall
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head above most people: ducking through old doorways, knees against the seat in front, being asked to reach the top shelf, and sleeves that never reach the wrist.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

nodes.label: thick-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute.

nodes.label: thin
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little body fat: shopping the smaller sizes, belts cinched to the last hole, room to spare in any seat, and feeling the cold before anyone else.

nodes.label: thin-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days.

nodes.label: tight (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding many strong rules of conduct, expecting them to apply in nearly every situation, having little tolerance for anyone who steps outside them, and wanting structure and self-restraint.

nodes.label: tough (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length.

nodes.label: traditional
nodes.gloss: This means showing preference for established methods, conventional wisdom, proven approaches, and time-tested practices over new or experimental alternatives.

nodes.label: transparent
nodes.gloss: This means communicating with complete openness and clarity, revealing all relevant information without hiding or obscuring anything, acknowledging uncertainties and limitations directly, and being forthright about what one does and doesn't know.

nodes.label: trapped-in-job
nodes.gloss: This means staying in a job one would quit tomorrow if one could: held there by the pension, the mortgage and the years already sunk in, and dreading every Monday.

nodes.label: traumatized
nodes.gloss: This means still living inside what happened: jumping at a slammed door, the scene coming back uninvited by day and in dreams, avoiding whatever brings it back, and never feeling safe.

nodes.label: treacherous
nodes.gloss: This means turning on one's friends, partner and team when it pays, selling their secrets, and switching sides the moment the other side offers more.

nodes.label: trustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means being worthy of others' trust, keeping one's word when breaking it would pay: holding to a promise gone costly, telling the truth when shading it would help, and keeping a confidence.

nodes.label: truthful
nodes.gloss: This means presenting information accurately and completely, avoiding lies, fabrication, or misrepresentation of facts, and correcting misunderstandings rather than exploiting them.

nodes.label: turbulent
nodes.gloss: This means being stormy inside and restless outside, swinging from one feeling to the next, never at peace or serene for long, and carrying the churn into everything one says.

nodes.label: unadventurous
nodes.gloss: This means keeping to the familiar and the safe: saying no to the unfamiliar place, food or plan, taking the known route every time, and growing uneasy outside routine.

nodes.label: unambitious
nodes.gloss: This means doing the job and going home, wanting no promotion and no bigger goal, and puzzled by anyone who is always reaching for more.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

nodes.label: uncalculating
nodes.gloss: This means acting with no thought for advantage: taking each moment as it comes, treating people as people, not pieces in a plan, and leaving one's own interests out of the reckoning.

nodes.label: uncaring
nodes.gloss: This means wishing nobody well and nobody ill: how other people fare is their own business, and one acts with no thought for who ends up helped or hurt.

nodes.label: uncritical
nodes.gloss: This means accepting the official account and the existing arrangement as simply how things are, never asking who benefits or what the accepted story leaves out.

nodes.label: uneducated
nodes.gloss: This means having left school at sixteen without a diploma, with no lectures, exams or theses behind one, and working for a living ever since.

nodes.label: unfair
nodes.gloss: This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included.

nodes.label: unfashionable
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing or caring what is in style, wearing the same clothes year after year, and blind to how dated one looks.

nodes.label: unflappable
nodes.gloss: This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered.

nodes.label: unflinching
nodes.gloss: This means taking up the awkward question, the painful subject and the tangled situation head-on, dealing with them fully rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague.

nodes.label: unforgiving
nodes.gloss: This means holding firmly to grievances, refusing to overlook transgressions, insisting on accountability and consequences, and prioritizing justice or retribution over reconciliation and second chances.

nodes.label: ungrateful
nodes.gloss: This means taking every kindness, gift and favor for granted, never saying thank you, forgetting who helped, and never repaying them.

nodes.label: unhappily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being sick of the partner one has, dreading going home to them, and sure one would not choose them again.

nodes.label: unhurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in no hurry about anything, treating nothing as pressing, letting things wait until convenient, and assuming that whatever it is will keep.

nodes.label: uninsured
nodes.gloss: This means having no health insurance: putting off the doctor until it cannot wait, paying cash at the urgent care, guessing at what a visit will cost, and hoping nothing serious happens.

nodes.label: unplugged
nodes.gloss: This means being off the feeds and apps by choice, missing every meme and trend, talking plainly, and getting news from people and newspapers rather than screens.

nodes.label: unpopular
nodes.gloss: This means not being liked by anyone in the class or the office, picked last, left off every invitation, and missed by nobody when away.

nodes.label: unreliable
nodes.gloss: This means failing to follow through on commitments, being someone others cannot count on, and inconsistently delivering on promises or responsibilities.

nodes.label: unrepentant
nodes.gloss: This means shrugging off the harm one has done, feeling no guilt over it however bad it was, never apologizing, and seeing nothing to make right.

nodes.label: unschooled
nodes.gloss: This means being unbookish, knowing only what everyday life and common sense have taught, and putting it in plain words with no framework, reference or theory.

nodes.label: unselfconscious
nodes.gloss: This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought.

nodes.label: unsentimental
nodes.gloss: This means throwing out old cards and keepsakes, dry-eyed at goodbyes and anniversaries, and never letting fondness for people or places sway a choice.

nodes.label: unsupported
nodes.gloss: This means having nobody in one's corner: no one to drive one home from the hospital, to lend the rent, to listen after a bad day, and carrying every load alone.

nodes.label: untrustworthy
nodes.gloss: This means being someone whose failures look motivated: breaking promises when keeping them stops paying, shading the truth, leaking what was told in confidence, and generally serving one's own interest at others' expense, in ways that give others good reason not to rely on one's word.

nodes.label: urban
nodes.gloss: This means living in the city, a wall away from the nearest neighbor and a short walk from the store, the days set by the train and the traffic.

nodes.label: violent
nodes.gloss: This means settling things with one's fists: answering a slight with a blow, reaching for whatever is at hand in a quarrel, or beating someone long after they are down.

nodes.label: vulnerable-narcissistic
nodes.gloss: This means feeling owed special treatment and never getting it: privately sure of being exceptional, stung by the smallest slight, envious of whoever is noticed, and withdrawing to brood instead of asking for anything.

nodes.label: wealthy
nodes.gloss: This means living on a high income, owning a spacious home and investments besides, and paying for comfort, fine meals or the best doctor without a thought for cost.

nodes.label: well-behaved
nodes.gloss: This means no pranks, no teasing, no bending a rule for fun, keeping everything orderly, and frowning on anyone who stirs things up.

nodes.label: well-connected
nodes.gloss: This means having friends and contacts everywhere, always someone to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: wide-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means seeing everything as if new, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks take one's breath away.

nodes.label: wise
nodes.gloss: This means seeing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning from experience, and giving advice that still holds up years later.

nodes.label: witty
nodes.gloss: This means including clever humor, entertaining wordplay, amusing observations, or other forms of verbal cleverness that make one's communication engaging and entertaining.

nodes.label: worldly
nodes.gloss: This means having seen enough of how people and deals really go to know the tricks, reading between the lines, and checking before believing.

nodes.label: wry
nodes.gloss: This means meeting life's small absurdities with quiet, low-key amusement: a raised eyebrow, a deadpan aside or a half-smile at one's own bad luck, with nobody made the butt of the joke.

nodes.label: xenophobic
nodes.gloss: This means distrusting foreigners on sight: bristling at an accent or a foreign name, sure the newcomers bring crime and take what is ours, and wanting them gone.

nodes.label: young
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

nodes.label: aimless
nodes.gloss: This means drifting through life without any goal or direction, taking each day as it comes, committing to nothing, and having no sense of what one is working toward.

nodes.label: chattering
nodes.gloss: This means talking on and on in a quick, easy stream, filling every pause with small remarks, asides and passing thoughts, and rarely letting a silence settle.

nodes.label: crude
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and joking in a coarse, vulgar way, with rough language and crude humor, and showing no concern for polish or refinement in one's manner.

nodes.label: deft
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks with a quick, skilled touch, working with one's hands in a way that is precise, nimble and easy to watch.

nodes.label: insulting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish.

nodes.label: jumpy
nodes.gloss: This means being easily startled and keeping a nervous edge, so that sudden noises, movements, or unexpected news set one on alert as a matter of temperament.

nodes.label: morose
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sullen, dour mood and withdrawing into silence, showing little willingness to talk and answering others, when one answers at all, with grudging short replies.

nodes.label: obscene
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a crudely lewd manner, using sexually offensive language and innuendo that shocks or disgusts those who hear it.

nodes.label: parasitic
nodes.gloss: This means living off other people's labor, resources, or goodwill while taking what one can and giving nothing back in return.

nodes.label: repressed
nodes.gloss: This means keeping one's feelings locked away, holding them in and refusing to let them show even when they press hard for expression.

nodes.label: rugged
nodes.gloss: This means facing hardship without complaint, enduring discomfort and setbacks through one's own resilience, and handling problems alone rather than leaning on others for help.

nodes.label: unladylike
nodes.gloss: This means behaving rudely, coarsely and boisterously, with loud talk, crude jokes and rough manners that flout genteel expectations for women and never bother to hide it.
